## Hero visual

The van photo shows the parts racks, which backs the one-visit claim. Cropped to the plumber and racks so it reads at 360 px below the CTA.

## Image specs

WebP at 640 and 1280 px wide with JPEG fallback, under 120 KB each, width and height attributes set on every img.

## Rejected visuals

A stock photo of a smiling plumber with a wrench: it proves nothing and customers have seen it on every competitor site.
